an6.13:2.5: It’s impossible, reverend, it cannot happen that the heart’s release by compassion has been developed and properly implemented,
an6.13:2.6: yet somehow the thought of harming still occupies the mind.
an6.13:3.5: It’s impossible, reverend, it cannot happen that the heart’s release by rejoicing has been developed and properly implemented,
an6.13:3.6: yet somehow discontent still occupies the mind.
an6.13:4.5: It’s impossible, reverend, it cannot happen that the heart’s release by equanimity has been developed and properly implemented,
an6.13:4.6: yet somehow desire still occupies the mind.
an6.13:5.5: It’s impossible, reverend, it cannot happen that the signless release of the heart has been developed and properly implemented,
an6.13:5.6: yet somehow consciousness still follows after signs.
